text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho,
where it is said that 'the 
strongest Umamusume' of the Classic
Triple 
Crown wins... That day has arrived.

The Trainer gave Super Creek's
"abilities" 
their full endorsement and prepared to 
send her off to the race.

However, she replied that rather than raw 
"ability," the "strength of their bond" 
was what truly mattered.

Having proven just that,
she walked toward 
the venue with a refreshed look on her 
face, as if the shackles that had bound 
her had finally fallen away.
